title: Synthetic single-dose oral plasma PK
description: Noise-free synthetic plasma concentrations for a one-compartment first-order oral absorption model (ka = 1.50 1/h, CL/F = 0.25 L/h/kg, V/F = 1.0 L/kg, dose = 2.0 mg/kg). Predose and 24 h samples are below the 0.02 ug/mL LLOQ and stored as BLQ. Research-use synthetic fixture only.
